newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian 96/97 FDI inflow hit $4.0 bln - Chidambaram.
newsitem.headline: Indian 96/97 FDI inflow hit $4.0 bln - Chidambaram.

text.p: Foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows into India hit $4.0 billion in 1996/97 (April-March), rising from $2.5 billion in 1995/96, United News of India (UNI) reported Finance Minister P. Chidambaram as saying on Thursday.
UNI said Chidambaram told India's upper house of parliament, Rajya Sabha, that he was confident the country would achieve a target of $10 billion annual FDI inflow within four years.
